final_answer:
Note on comparability: Meta reports this line item as "revenue," while Amazon reports it as "net sales." Although these terms label the top-line figure differently, both represent total sales/revenue for a fiscal year ending in the same period (calendar year 2023 and 2024), so a growth-rate comparison is reasonably valid, though the underlying business models (advertising vs. e-commerce/cloud) differ substantially.

Meta Platforms revenue grew from $134,902M in FY2023 to $164,501M in FY2024 [DOC-1], a growth rate of:
(164,501 − 134,902) / 134,902 = 29,599 / 134,902 ≈ 21.94%

Amazon.com net sales grew from $574,785M in FY2023 to $637,959M in FY2024 [DOC-1], a growth rate of:
(637,959 − 574,785) / 574,785 = 63,174 / 574,785 ≈ 10.99%

Meta's revenue growth rate (≈21.94%) exceeded Amazon's net sales growth rate (≈10.99%) by approximately 10.95 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 11 percentage points (≈21.9% vs. ≈11.0%).
